title: Enrichment
description: Add context to events inside the pipeline — before routing and detection.

egress.warning_one: {{count}} source sends indicators from your environment to an external service. Requires per-organization opt-in.
egress.warning_other: {{count}} sources send indicators from your environment to external services. They require per-organization opt-in.

tables.emptyDescription: Customer tables (CMDB, network plan, allowlist) are matched by exact key or by the most specific CIDR prefix.

form.name: Name
form.nameRequired: Enter a name for the table.
form.matchModeExactHint: Compares the event's key by exact equality.
form.matchModeCidrHint: Compares an IP by the MOST SPECIFIC network prefix that contains it.
form.organizationRequired: Select an organization — there is no global enrichment table.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete table
deleteConfirm.description: This removes "{{name}}" and its whole version history. Only possible if no policy references it.

versions.title: Versions — {{name}}
versions.rowsHelperExact: Object {key: {field: value}}. The key is compared by exact equality.
versions.rowsHelperCidr: Object {cidr: {field: value}}. Each key must be an IP or a CIDR range (e.g. 10.0.5.0/24).
versions.mustBeObject: The content must be an object {key: {field: value}}, not a list.
versions.invalidJson: Invalid JSON — check commas and braces.

policies.emptyDescription: A policy defines which enrichment rules run and where the result is written.

form.name: Name
form.nameRequired: Enter a name for the policy.
form.organizationRequired: Select an organization — there is no global enrichment policy.

versions.title: Versions — {{name}}
versions.enabledNow: This policy is ACTIVE — it applies to new events for this organization.
versions.rulesEmpty: Add at least one rule before publishing.
versions.tableHint: Only used by table enrichers (table_exact, table_cidr).
versions.keySourceHint: Path inside the normalized event, e.g.: normalized.src_endpoint.ip
versions.tagsHint: Written to _centralops.enrichment_tags — usable in other rules' conditions and in routes.

dryRun.title: Test before publishing
dryRun.hint: Applies the rules above to a sample event, without publishing anything or touching real traffic.
dryRun.tablesHint: {rule_id: {key: {field: value}}} — test without publishing the real table.
dryRun.needsRules: Add at least one rule before testing.
dryRun.invalidSample: The sample event is not valid JSON.
dryRun.invalidTables: The simulated tables are not valid JSON.

versions.sourceRequired: Required: this enricher needs a credential.
versions.sourceHint: The credential lives in the source, never in the rule.

sources.emptyDescription: A source is an instance of an enricher in this organization — the endpoint and credential it runs with here.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete source
deleteConfirm.description: This removes "{{name}}" and its credential. Only possible if no policy references it.

form.name: Name
form.nameRequired: Enter a name for the source.
form.nameImmutable: The name cannot change after creation — rules reference it.
form.organizationRequired: Select an organization — the credential is bound to it.
form.secretHint: Sent once and encrypted by the server; the API never returns it. Required: {{names}}.
